title: Titanium Thermowell
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Thermowell where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Temperature sensor protective thermowell requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by temperature sensor protective thermowell and service environment demands.
process: CNC machining CP Ti for tank hardware geometry
TIG welding Ti filler with 0.5mm corner radius
Pickling and passivation with 0.5mm corner radius
Continuity test <1 mOhm with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells — tailored for temperature sensor protective application
commonFailures: Contact burn at rack hook from insufficient clamp - resolved by BeCu spring contact 5N minimum force — critical for temperature sensor protective performance

faq.q: What bath chemistries is Titanium Thermowell resistant to?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti used in Titanium Thermowell resists attack in hexavalent chromium plating baths (250 g/L CrO₃), sulfuric acid anodizing (15-20% H₂SO₄), nickel sulfamate (300 g/L Ni), and cyanide-based solutions where steel racks corrode at >5 mm/month. Service life in these environments exceeds 12 months continuous immersion for temperature sensor protective.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Thermowell orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Thermowell is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Thermowell?
faq.a: Each Titanium Thermowell shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for temperature sensor protective.
